messages:
sam_pm: Hi team — quick thread to land a proposal: introduce a 'migration hedge' program for catalog lifecycle. Purpose: accelerate sunsetting low-quality models while protecting customers financially & operationally. Core pieces: 1) benchmark-based retire triggers, 2) tiered migration credits, 3) SLA hedges (rollback window + canary protection), 4) comm templates and in-console opt-outs. Ideas?
tanya_eng: +1. Need to define the trigger math: prefer a hybrid rule: (A) relative delta > 7% vs pinned baseline OR (B) consistent tail-regression on top-3 prompts. Require min sample size (n>=2k) in 14d. Also propose a probation phase: mark as "at-risk" for 7d before any dry-run.
alex_csm: for GTM, credits must be clear: self-serve -> token credit (25k), scale startups -> invoice credit $200, enterprise -> custom credit and CS involvement. Enterprise contracts should opt into automatic hedging; otherwise manual review. Comms must include clear rollback SLA and a named contact.
nina_sre: operational constraints: dry-run traffic isolation is mandatory (no shared cache). Add tracing tag: catalog.migrate.cohort=<id>. Failure thresholds: page if error-rate > 1.5x baseline or latency p95 > 30% for 30m. We need a one-click global abort and per-tenant kill switch.
tanya_eng: proposal for sequence: 1) detect at-risk -> notify tenant 2) 7d probation -> if persisting, spawn MigrationPlan: dry-run 1% for 5d -> ramp 10% 48h -> canary 100% 1h -> finalize. Billing: apply credits for dry-run & ramp phases. Example config: `trigger: {window:14d, min_calls:2000, rel_delta:0.07}; phases: [{name:dryrun,pct:0.01,days:5,credit:token},{name:ramp,pct:0.10,hours:48,credit:invoice}]`
sam_pm: thanks. Product gates: - self-serve: auto probation + dry-run unless opt-out - enterprise: require CS sign-off before dry-run - partners/manual: manual only. Also need an audit log for legal/finance.
alex_csm: will draft comm templates and a migration FAQ. Also request a finance-safe table mapping token credits to approximate invoice credit for clarity.
nina_sre: runbook notes: synthetic traffic validator for cohort, dashboard per-tenant, automated revert script `curl -X POST /admin/revert?tenant=...` and an alert to eng-oncall.
billing-bot: Reminder: apply credit ledger entries with tag "migration_hedge" for dry-run windows.
tanya_eng: dev tasks: 1) evaluator & stats lib 2) MigrationPlan API 3) routing gate + isolation 4) billing credit hook 5) UI for opt-out + review 6) runbook automation. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for initial pilot.
sam_pm: prioritization: Q2 experiment to reduce long-tail maintenance and lower support load. Propose pilot cohort of 80 low-touch tenants starting 2024-06-10. I'll write short PRD and link back here.
alex_csm: I'll prep CS pilot invites and finance notes.
nina_sre: will prep alert rules and synthetic tests.
tanya_eng: will spike stats approach this week and share findings.
sam_pm: great. I'll post PRD draft by Friday. If no objections, lock thresholds at 7%/14d/min 2k for pilot. :thumbsup:
